div.head: EGu 6.1
div.ab: Gyf hwá Rómfeoh forhealde, gylde lahslitt mid Denum, wíte mid Englum.
Gif hwa Rómfeoh forhealde, gylde lahslit mid Denum, wíte mid Englum.
Si quis Romfeoh superteneat, reddat lahslit cum Dacis, witam cum Anglis.
Gif hwa Rómfeoh forhealde, gylde lahslit mid Denum, wíte mid Englum.
Gif hwa Romfeoh forhealde, gylde lahslit mid Denum, wite mid Englum.
If anyone withholds Peter's Pence, he shall pay lahslit in a Danish district, and a fine in an English district.
If anyone withholds the dues owed to Rome, he shall pay lahslit among the Danes or a penalty among the English.
Wenn jemand Romgeld [den Peterspfennig] vorenthält, zahle er Rechtsbruchbusse bei den Dänen, Strafgeld bei den Engländern.
If anyone withholds Rome-money [Peter’s Pence], let him pay the penalty for breach of law among the Danes, a fine among the English.
div.note: dues to Rome: “Peter’s Pence,” a penny tax paid each Feast of Saint Peter to support the Holy See in Rome.
